custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding an open part request for part A, requested and not received.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test, on no part request.
  • Use two new part numbers that no part uses, one exactly 51 characters long and one exactly 60 characters long.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425718 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425718-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
  2. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425718 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  3. Request part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options. In the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425718-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library. Type 1 in Quantity. Click Save Part. Do not receive it.
  4. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425718 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425718-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
